an6.82:1.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an6.82:1.3: Musāvādī hoti, pisuṇāvāco hoti, pharusāvāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti, luddho ca, pagabbho ca.
an6.82:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 3.
an6.82:2.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an6.82:2.3: Musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāvācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāvācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, aluddho ca, appagabbho ca.
an6.82:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
